issue_context.title: Compiler output bloat
comments: I think this is because images have an attribute that is an expression. This is inlined thanks to your PR but we never changes the logic that skip that element if it is full inlined to include that. I think it should be doable

Sibling calls are not side-effect free during hydration. They are needed to move the hydration node. However like mentioned above, we are likely missing logic for the skipping of code due to the attribute expression. Marking it as dynamic.

Oh, I see. Yeah:

https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/blob/1e5a385c968afb302beb38e7d8dd2982fdd66d0c/packages/svelte/src/internal/client/dom/operations.js#L149

I may have had a memory of how this worked from before hydration was implemented
